items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [MockServer (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/mock-server/mockserver-monorepo) - Mocking, debugging proxy and chaos engineering tool for multiple protocols (HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, LLM, MCP, Kafka, TCP and more); mock any dependency, record/replay and inspect traffic, verify requests, and inject faults. Docker, JAR, Helm, multi-language clients.

### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [tapflow (⭐42)](https://github.com/jo-duchan/tapflow) - Self-hosted mobile QA tool that streams iOS simulators and Android emulators to the browser for team-wide testing without local setup.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### MCP Servers

*   [TWZRD Agent Intel](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/mcp) - Trust scoring and identity verification for AI agent wallets on Solana. Verify agent identity before x402 micropayments or agent-initiated operations. Free: `score_agent`, `preflight_check`. Paid (x402): `get_trust_receipt`. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.
